hints.title: Subarray End Contributions
hints.text: Every element contributes a number of strictly increasing subarrays ending at itself equal to the length of the contiguous increasing sequence up to that index.

hints.title: Current Streak Maintenance
hints.text: Maintain the current run length of strictly increasing numbers. Increment by 1 if nums[i] is greater than nums[i-1], otherwise reset to 1.

hints.title: Running Sum Accumulation
hints.text: Add the current streak length to the cumulative answer at each index.

hints.title: Single Pass Streak Accumulator Implementation

complexity.notes: Single linear iteration tracking current increasing length.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Checking all O(n^2) pairs of indices leads to quadratic time overhead.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: O(1) memory by maintaining streak state without allocating arrays.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognizes that counting subarrays reduces to summing segment lengths in linear time.
